Savona Foodservice has officially opened the doors to its new London distribution depot, marking an exciting new chapter for our business and a significant investment in our future across London and the South East.

As our customer base and product range have continued to grow, so has the need for greater capacity. The 50,000 square foot site has given us a larger, more efficient facility designed to support our customers today while preparing us for future growth.

At the heart of the expansion is a significant increase in warehouse capacity, including over c. 2,000 additional freezer and chiller pallet spaces. This means greater product availability and the ability to offer an even broader range of products.

# Route2 Logistics opens new Coatbridge depot

 by Transport News | Aug 13, 2026 | Hot News

### Route2 Logistics has officially opened its new depot in Coatbridge, marking a major milestone in the continued growth of the specialist haulage and pallet distribution business.

The new 22,000sq ft facility provides additional warehousing, yard space and vehicle capacity, creating a significant new operational base for Route2 in the West of Scotland and complementing its Dunfermline operation.

The company said the new site creates a stronger Scotland-based network, enabling the business to provide faster lead times, greater capacity and greater flexibility for companies delivering products to customers across Scotland.

Marc Batey, commercial manager at Route2 Logistics, said: “Dunfermline has been our foundation for Route2 in the East of Scotland. Opening a depot further West is the next step in building a stronger, more connected Scottish network.

“Coatbridge puts us right in the heart of the Central Belt and gives us a much stronger position from which to serve customers across Scotland.”

# ​Dutch logistics firm ODIN launches UK branch at Immingham

By Carol Millett 2026-09-14T16:30:00+01:00

Dutch company ODIN Warehousing and Logistics is continuing its expansion into the UK with the opening of ODIN Transport & Shipping UK which will initially focus on accompanied and unaccompanied trailer transport between the UK and the European mainland.

The launch builds on ODIN’s acquisition of Welton North Sea Trailers in January this year and sees the Welton team and its fleet integrated into the business.

Alongside the launch, ODIN announced it is scaling up the operation by adding 50 to 100 extra trailers to the fleet and collaborating directly with localised British hauliers.

ODIN Transport & Shipping UK will be responsible for organising British planning, local customer contacts, customs coordination and the build-up of return loads from the Immingham region.

The business will also work closely with ODIN’s transport and warehousing activities in the Netherlands and with an existing network of carriers and logistics partners.

# Leicestershire logistics firm unveils major expansion after nearly 32% growth

28 Aug 2026 | by MHW Magazine Team | Logistics, News

Translink plans to turn its 66,000 sq ft Narborough site into a major indoor pallet sortation centre

A fast-growing Leicestershire logistics firm has announced a major leadership shake-up and plans for a huge new pallet sortation centre after recording almost 32% growth in two years.

Translink Express Logistics has made four senior appointments as the family-run business prepares to celebrate its 40th anniversary next summer.

Three existing employees have been promoted, with Lee Barrett becoming head of traffic, Dan Green taking on the newly created role of head of project management, and Shanice Walsh appointed head of operations.

Ryan Wallis has also joined the company as head of warehousing.

The new management team will take greater responsibility for the day-to-day running of the business, allowing its directors to focus more closely on longer-term growth plans.

# XDP adds Carlisle out-of-gauge freight capacity

August 14, 2026

XDP expands Carlisle capacity for irregular and out-of-gauge freight flows. The 4,941ft² depot serves 67 northern and Scottish postcodes. 

#### IN Brief:

- XDP's new Carlisle depot provides 4,941ft² of operational space.
- The facility serves 67 postcodes across north-west England and southern Scotland.
- XDP says the site adds regional capacity and supports shorter transit times across the coverage area.

XDP has opened a 4,941ft² depot in Carlisle to increase regional capacity for irregular and out-of-gauge freight across north-west England and southern Scotland.

The facility is fully operational and serves 67 postcodes. XDP says the location closes a gap in its regional network and is intended to support shorter transit times and additional capacity for customers across the surrounding area.

# Evri invests £1.3m in new Gloucester parcel depot

 October 12, 2026 Mark Salisbury Filed under: Last Mile Deliveries, Logistics, Manufacturer News, News, Newsletter, Secondary News, Third-Party Logistics (3PL) 

Evri Group has opened a new £1.3 million depot in Gloucester, expanding its parcel delivery network across the South West and creating dozens of permanent jobs.

The new facility at Indurent Park Gloucester in Quedgeley replaces the company’s previous operation in Tewkesbury, which had reached capacity. The investment will help Evri manage rising parcel volumes, strengthen regional operations and improve its ability to meet customer demand.

The depot has created 38 permanent roles across warehouse, driving, operational and management functions. The investment also supports local employment while providing additional capacity for the growing logistics business.
